messages:
maria: Ping for review on PR #2456 — updates for AcmeCorp private VPC overlay (fixes route leaking + healthcheck timeout). Need an approval to merge and a backport to release-2.1. PR: https://git.redwood/inference/pull/2456 can someone take a look?

sam: @maria :eyes: assigning to me, I'll try to review before lunch.

lee: quick Q — tests failing locally for the healthcheck timeout tweak, can you paste the config diff?

maria: added snippet in PR description but pasting here:
```yaml
healthcheck:
  interval: 5s
  timeout: 10s
network:
  route_table: overlay-acme-01
  allow_ip_ranges: [192.168.10.0/24]
```
The change reduces timeout to 10s (was 20s).

lee: hmm lowering timeout might flake on high load; do we have an e2e that exercises control-plane latency?

julian: we do have acme-private e2e in CI but it's flaky. I added a gate job `acme-canary` to run post-merge.

maria: CI showed one integration fail earlier, but fixed in latest commit. Also added a config toggle `ACME_DISABLE_ROUTE_LEAK_FIX=false` so canary can opt-out.

deploy-bot: CI update for PR #2456: status=FAILED, job=integration-acme-1 (timeout), details: https://ci.redwood/2456

sam: I'll re-run CI and check logs.

sam: logs show kube-proxy restart causing delay, looks unrelated. Approving when canary run passes. :thumbsup:

maria: @sam thanks — can we also backport to release-2.1? customer is on 2.1.

lee: if merging to main, please add a release note and link to customer ticket #ACME-987.

maria: done, added release note and linked ticket.

sam: re-run CI: https://ci.redwood/2456/retry — acme-canary job queued.

deploy-bot: acme-canary: status=PASS

sam: :shipit: merging to main after a quick squash. I'll open backport PR to release-2.1.

maria: ty! once backport PR is open I'll message account team.

julian: noted. post-merge: monitor acme-private cluster for 2 hours. I'll keep an eye.
